title: Open neighbourhood restrictions detect ambient derived isomorphisms
statement: Let X be a scheme with shared derived categories on X and every open subscheme [def-pc-derived-category]. Let phi:A to B be any ambient derived morphism. If for every x in X there is an open U containing x such that exact derived restriction of phi to U [def-pc-derived-open-restriction-maps] is invertible, then phi is invertible. No qcqs, quasi-coherence or boundedness assumption is imposed.

source.place: Tag 0AAB locality step; Tag 04TN sheaf locality, applied to each cohomology sheaf

proof.text: Index the cover by all opens U for which the exact derived restriction of phi is invertible. The pointwise neighbourhood assumption implies the supremum of these opens is top. This uses Opens.mem_iSup and does not choose any unproved object.

For each degree n use the proved source-library mapDerivedCategoryHomologyFunctorIso and NatIso.isIso_map_iff to make exact restriction of H^n(phi) invertible. Reflect this through the equivalence Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U to get invertibility of H^n(phi).over U.

Apply sheaf_module_isIso_iff_isIso_over_open_cover to the degree-n morphism on this cover. Thus all homology morphisms are invertible. Mathlib DerivedCategory.isIso_iff gives invertibility of phi. Empty schemes and unbounded complexes are included.

lean.statement:
theorem schemeDerived_isIso_of_openRestriction
    [∀ Z : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {A B : schemeDerivedCategory X} (φ : A ⟶ B)
    (hlocal : ∀ x : X, ∃ U : X.Opens, x ∈ U ∧
      IsIso ((schemeOpenRestriction X U).mapDerivedCategory.map φ)) :
    IsIso φ
